title.value: Singularity: Planet-Scale, Preemptive and Elastic Scheduling of AI Workloads
title.justification: The title is directly extracted from the paper metadata on arXiv.
title.quote: Singularity: Planet-Scale, Preemptive and Elastic Scheduling of AI Workloads

extractions.description: The paper discusses Singularity, a globally distributed scheduling service developed by Microsoft for optimizing AI workload execution. It introduces novel mechanisms that allow deep learning workloads to be preempted and resized dynamically, improving utilization and reliability across a global fleet of AI accelerators. These mechanisms enable transparent checkpointing, preemption, and elasticity without the need for user code modifications, aiming to drive down AI costs by maximizing throughput and minimizing idle resources.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on optimizing AI workload scheduling to improve efficiency and reliability in cloud environments, rather than directly addressing climate or ecological sustainability issues.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: To achieve the above three goals, Singularity relies on two key core scheduling primitives: Preemption and Migration, Resizing/Elasticity.

primary_category.justification: The paper centers around AI workload scheduling efficiency and does not primarily target Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development.
primary_category.quote: Singularity is a fully managed, globally distributed infrastructure service for AI workloads at Microsoft, with support for diverse hardware accelerators.

secondary_categories.justification: No aspect of the paper discusses Climate or Ecologically-Related Sustainable Development themes such as renewable energy, pollution reduction, or ecosystem protection.
secondary_categories.quote: We present Singularity, Microsoft’s globally distributed scheduling service for highly-efficient and reliable execution of deep learning training and inference workloads.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories provided do not address AI scheduling optimization, which is the main theme of the paper.
primary_sub_category.quote: All jobs in Singularity are preemptible, migratable, and dynamically resizable (elastic) by default.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The sub-categories related to environmental sustainability are not applicable to this study, which focuses on computational efficiency in AI workloads.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Singularity adapts to increasing load on an inference job, freeing up capacity by elastically scaling down or preempting training jobs.

applications.justification: The application of Singularity primarily lies in increasing AI workload efficiency through preemptive and elastic scheduling, which the paper details extensively.
applications.quote: At the heart of Singularity is a novel, workload-aware scheduler that can transparently preempt and elastically scale deep learning workloads to drive high utilization without impacting their correctness or performance.

new_primary_category.value: Computational Efficiency and Cloud Resource Optimization
new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on optimizing the distribution and execution of AI workloads across global cloud resources, thus suggesting a broader category that emphasizes computational resource efficiency.
new_primary_category.quote: Singularity is built with one key goal: driving down the cost of AI by maximizing the aggregate useful throughput on a given fixed pool of capacity of accelerators at planet scale.

new_primary_sub_category.value: AI Workload Scheduling and Resource Management
new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-category is defined to reflect the core theme of improving scheduling and resource management for AI workloads, which is central to the paper.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: To scale up or scale down a job, we simply change the number of devices the workers are mapped to.
